name: Simeon
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: Niger comes from the Niger River, which extends throughout Africa; it is a Latin word that means black.
Simeon was called black because he came from the area of the Niger River. Your ministers never expounded on that; they are busy taking your money.

note.label: NDEFCAM Radio | Cameroon, Africa | THE CHOSEN PEOPLE

points: “Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called” Niger. That word right there is Latin and it just means black. They pronounce it a certain way in Egypt today, and they pronounce it Niger so that they don’t offend sensitive black people. Some of you are very sensitive about words, but that is not the pronunciation, and it’s not ‘Niger’ like the country either. With all this talk of ECOWAS wanting to attack Niger over a coup, when most of the ECOWAS presidents got in by a coup themselves, the word matters.

How do we know? Go inside the book Africa’s Gift to America: ‘These first Africans were variously called Niger, from River Niger, Ethiopian’, and Niger was pronounced not Niger, but the way the Southerner said it. I ain’t making nothing up; y’all thought I was being offensive, but I got books to show you how it was pronounced. All of that was to cover up that last word. Don’t be fooled into thinking it was called Niger. When you hear that word everybody knows, and a lot of these old Christians are feeling it through the TV right now. That was the purpose of why they called us that: they wanted us to feel it. Now all of a sudden they act like we’re okay, but in the meantime they treat us like that and tell you you’re all right in Jesus.

note.label: The Return of Isaiah & The Fall of Arabia

points: “Simeon that was called Niger”: Niger means black. They were called black.
